resources.string: Simple shows the basics, like other keyboards. Standard adds the common extras. Everything shows every setting. A setting that is not shown keeps its value, and search still finds it.
The basics and the common extras
A row at the end of each group that opens what the depth left out

The settings depth leaves some settings out of each page. With this on, a group that has hidden settings ends in a row that says how many there are, and a tap on it shows them in place. With this off, the hidden settings leave no mark, and search is the way to find them. This setting is off by default.
Settings that need another setting turned on stay in view, greyed out, instead of hiding

Some settings only matter while another setting is on, and they normally hide until then. With this on, they stay on the page, greyed out, so you can see everything a feature offers before you turn it on. A long press on a greyed row says which setting it waits for. This setting is off by default.
Other paths under the path bar
An \"Also under\" line naming the other ways you reached a page

Some pages can be reached by more than one path. Under the path bar, a line named Also under lists the other paths to the page you are on. Turn this off to get that line\'s room back. This setting is on by default.
It belongs to the %1$s settings, and you are on %2$s. You can see it because you came straight here, and it hides again once you leave. You can change this any time under About › App.
This page is showing extra settings
You are on %1$s, which leaves some of these out. You can see them because you came straight here, and they hide again once you leave. You can change this any time under About › App.
